name: Alfina
source:
Alfina is a private female teacher who lives in the same village as [url=https://vndb.org/c29769]Haresu[/url]. She is a good advisor and acts like an older sister to him. She is probably the most intellectual person in the village and she is also sexually very attractive.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=17]MangaGamer[/url]]
